about: Atlas spelling dictionary. One standard: British English with -ise spellings. A word passes the text check (scripts/textcheck.mjs) if it is in the base dictionary, in terminologia, approved or proposed. Generated by scripts/build-dictionary.mjs; edit approved, proposed and decisions by hand.

terminologia.source: Terminologia Anatomica (TA98 and TA2) via Wikidata, CC0; 5922 terms, fetched 2026-11-24. English words converted to British spelling.

fetus.why: Standard in British medical writing, and the en-GB dictionary’s form.

grey.why: British spelling; “Gray” stays only as the name (Henry Gray, Gray’s Anatomy).

disc.why: British anatomical spelling (intervertebral disc, optic disc).

ise.why: One standard for the whole app (organise, recognise, ossification is unaffected).

proposed.ae: Letter pair, in the note on Gray’s spelling (æ written ae).
proposed.notesquote: Field name in the AI prompt.
proposed.oe: Letter pair, in the note on Gray’s spelling (œ written oe).
proposed.ok: Value name in the AI prompt (status “ok”).
proposed.sba: Question type name in the AI prompt and question files.
proposed.whynot: Field name in the AI prompt.

keep.specialty: British medical usage (NHS specialty training), not general “speciality”.
keep.sulfur: British medical and scientific usage (BNF, IUPAC), not general “sulphur”.
